from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NetIncome(BaseModel):
    """Consolidated net income as reported in one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written, e.g., 'Consolidated Net Income'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The net income amount; negative for losses")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025'")

class OperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Net cash from operating activities as reported in one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written, e.g., 'Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The net cash flow amount; negative for 'used' or 'net loss'")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    net_incomes: list[NetIncome]
    operating_cash_flows: list[OperatingCashFlow]
